estimand: mean within-case tumor-minus-normal difference for each gene/layer
cohort: intersection of case IDs in all four assays after tissue-specific exclusions
selection: Among non-prespecified protein genes with n >= 90% of common cohort and q < 0.05, select two largest absolute protein mean differences; ties alphabetical. RNA does not determine selection.
findings: VEGFA protein n=1, untestable. NDUFA4L2 maps to COXFA4L2/Q9NRX3.
